## Goal
Dashboard and owner chat get live events; nobody can subscribe to another tenant or owner.

## Owns
- `infra/cdk/lib/realtime-stack.ts`
- `services/live-publisher/**`

## Tests first (write them, see them fail, then implement)
- publish(): masks phone numbers, drops internal fields, maps event -> /tenants/<tid>/live; owner chat replies -> /owners/<sub>/chat.
- Integration test in dev: owner A cannot subscribe to /tenants/<B>/live.

## Steps
- Implement SigV4-signed HTTP publish to the AppSync Events endpoint.
- Verify onSubscribe handlers deny cross-tenant/cross-owner subscriptions.

## Acceptance
- booking.created appears in a subscribed client within 1 s in dev.

## Run
`pnpm vitest run services/live-publisher` and `make test` before opening the PR.
